prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic studio portrait of one original approved adult woman seated on a clean light-gray studio floor in a tailored black fashion look with supplied monogram elements.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with dark hair in a neat low updo, calm serious direct gaze, soft editorial makeup, and natural skin texture. She wears a structured black double-breasted blazer dress with puffed shoulders, an oversized white satin bow at the collar, supplied monogram-patterned sheer tights, white ankle socks, black leather loafers with gold-tone hardware, white gloves, and carries a supplied structured monogram handbag.
composition_elements: Subject seated side-oriented on the floor with torso upright, one hand supporting behind and legs extended diagonally.
Clean seamless light-gray to white background and continuous smooth floor.
Preserve monogram pattern and handbag as supplied brand assets without inventing new logos.
Keep bow, gloves, socks, loafers, pose, and direct gaze clear.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even studio illumination with controlled shadow, clean neutral background, realistic tailoring and leather highlights, and polished editorial clarity.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, 50mm lens at f/4, sharp face, tights, handbag, and tailoring detail, realistic skin, fabric, leather, and monogram texture, subtle grain, no text or watermark.
